sources_verbatim: {"source_id": "S0937", "path": "docs/knowledgeos/brainstorming/phase_measure_theory/20260828-103509_step-042-assurance-composition-invariants-safety-gates-and-formal-decision-contracts.md", "commit": "39fdef05dc027c6264b6c349a26362a59191a35f", "file_mtime": "1787906109", "mtime_block": null, "explicit_dates": [], "order_evidence": "STEP-NUMBER", "status": "CONTENT", "summary": "Step 42 of the phase_measure_theory step sequence: separates epistemic sufficiency from decision validity from authorized action, defines a formal Decision Contract DC(d) and an Admissible(d,K,t) predicate, a safety-gate/invariant taxonomy with a default unknown-invariant-blocks-safety policy, an assurance composition tree with dependency-closure-based incremental recomputation and non-monotonic assurance revision, an evaluate-vs-execute separation bounding AI agent authority, twelve falsification experiments (all PASS), and closes with a five-layer architecture (Governance/Decision/Epistemic/Semantic/Reality) before opening Step 43 on causal reasoning.", "objects_touched": ["decision-contract-admissibility-model", "safety-invariant-taxonomy-and-gate", "assurance-composition-tree", "kos-five-layer-architecture-model", "causal-reasoning-assurance-layer"], "contribution_assessment": "Introduces the formal Decision Contract / Admissibility model (Pre/Inv/Auth/Post/Temporal/Evidence, later refined to <P,I,A,E,Q,T,O>) as the central new construct of this step; formalizes invariants as a DDD-aggregate-owned taxonomy distinct from policy/advisory constraints; formalizes assurance as a dependency graph supporting incremental, non-monotonic recomputation; states the AI-proposes/system-decides architecture principle; runs 12 falsification tests (all PASS); previews Step 43's correlation-does-not-imply-causation question.", "provenance": "PRIMARY", "in_file_overlap_claim": null, "_batch_id": "B0023", "best_historical_date": "1787906109", "best_historical_date_basis": "MTIME"}
